column3: Fix compile errors if TAB_COMPLETE_FILENAME not defined.
Add WARNING about hilite_search with TAB chars.
Don't hilite_search line number displayed with -N.
Remove lesskey -f flag; add lesskey -V flag; lesskey defaults to .lesskey.in rather than stdin.
Convert cfgetospeed values to ospeed values.
Change default lesskey input file from .lesskey.in to .lesskey
Deal with tags file when pattern has a backslash.
Fix -k option: must init_cmds before opt_k.
Change highlighting: only highlite search results (but now it is reliable).
Add repaint_hilite and optimize highlight manipulation.
Fix bugs if highlighting line with backspaces and BS_SPECIAL is on.
Add SECURE to make it easier to build a secure version.
Use system WERASE char as EC_W_BACKSPACE cmd.
Change static hilite table to a dynamically-allocated linked list.
Change -F to -g; add -G functionality, like old hilite search (hilite every occurence).
Get rid of extraneous prep_hilites near end of file.
Allow EXTRA string after line-edit cmd in lesskey file.
Make filestate dynamic; implement LESSOPEN=|cmd feature.
Add -I flag; clean up quit(-1); start using TRUE,FALSE and OPT_OFF,OPT_ON,OPT_ONPLUS.
Formalize the four-byte header emitted by a LESSOPEN pipe.
Get rid of four-byte header for LESSOPEN pipe.
Close alt file before opening new one (avoid multiple popen's).
Back out thisfile==NULL changes.  Maybe later.
Check VISUAL before EDITOR environment variable.
Use VISUAL; use S_ISDIR/S_ISREG; fix config problem with Solaris POSIX regcomp.
Don't quit on read error or seek error.
Fix multi-file searches with LESSOPEN pipe.
Remove -L, old semantics of -l; add NO_QUERY.
Remove -L, old semantics of -l; add NO_QUERY.
Don't clear ch_ungotchar in ch_flush: we lose the char we ungot in open_altfile.
Don't call LESSOPEN on a pipe.
Fix ch_ungetchar overrun bug; lint cleanup.
Don't need to call fexpand in open_altfile (crashes on file "x%y").
Fix bug if chnage -G at EOF (prep_hilite must handle epos==NULL_POSITION).
Add "next" charset; don't display ^X for X > 128.
Add GNU options --help, --version; minor config fixes.
Clean up glob; don't set # if we can't open the new file.
Repeat search should turn on hilites.
Don't leave zombies if LESSOPEN pipe is empty.
Open output file in binary mode for dumb OSes.
Open console in O_BINARY for DOS.
Clean up homefile; make OS2 look in $HOME before $INIT,$PATH.
Error if "v" on LESSOPENed file; "%" figures out file size on a pipe.
Don't set # in lsystem; lesskey try $HOME first.
Fix hilite bug if overstrike multiple chars.
Allow lesskey to override get_editkey keys.
Fix adj_hilite bug when line gets processed by hilite_line more than once.
Add makefile targets configure and tagall.
Fix Makefile for subdirectory builds. Fix Sequent bug with incompatible sigsetmask.
Add #env stuff to lesskey. Fix MS-DOS build.
Use no_back_scroll, since get_term is done before init_option.
Add support for Borland C; fix arrow keys in MS-DOS versions.
Workaround Ultrix bug that doesn't set/restore line discipline.
Fix OS/2 bug in expanding filenames.
Use $srcdir to find version number in version.c
Don't call termcap functions if tgetent failed.
Fix search on squished file; add /@@.
Allow cmdbuf longer than screen width.
Make sure we don't call any termcap functions if tgetent fails. (Faults on Linux.)
Add ^K search modifier, clean up makefile.
Fix overflow in jump_percent calculation. Don't send "ti" after lsystem until user has pressed a key.
Remove references to shar/unshar, since distribution is normally a .tar.gz file now.
Make -U cause tabs to print as ^I.
Make hilites work in cmd F output.
Use OPEN_READ on call to open() tty.
Split authoring stuff out from standard Makefile into Makefile.author.
Fix command F to notice window-change signals.
Use newaction to make command F kludge a little less kludgy.
Don't force cmd.exe in OS/2 lsystem.
Use the term "option" rather than "flag" consistently.
Don't do final clear_bot() if output is not a tty.
tagpattern should point to alloc'ed memory, not stack.
Update OS/2 and DOS defines.h files.
If we're squished, we can't repaint hilites. Must repaint whole screen first.
Fix -d flag. Add "--" option to mark end of options. Beginning of port to OS-9.
Change glob() to lglob() to avoid conflicts.
Fix bug in tags: if pattern ends with "$" make sure we match to end-of-line.
Separate gcc makefile from Ultra C makefile.
Removed help file.  Help text is now embedded in less executable.
Use ch_getflags() & CH_HELPFILE instead of redundant helping flag.
Make sure screen is displayed before expanding editor prototype. Fixes B#143.
Allow to compile with CMD_HISTORY undefined. Fixes B#106.
Attempted to put screen.c into distribution twice.
Include mkhelp.c and mkfuncs.awk in the distribution.
Fix B#110. Add reedit_ifile to allow to continue after "cannot reopen" errors.
Don't use null ifiles in reedit_ifile.
Added horizontal scrolling (ESC-[ and ESC-] commands).
Change -e to quit on reaching end of a squished file.
Make |a when a < current screen, go to end of current screen.
Add Q command. Clarify some documentation.
Create ZIP archive. Make sure files in the archive have correct r/w permissions.
Mention lesskey as well as less
Don't write to console if standard output is not a tty.
Update with new INSTALL file from autoconf 2.9.
Back out v314 change to -e option. Cannot easily quit after one screen, because "te" will immediately erase the screen.
Fix reading of two-char keys for OS/2 build.
Display usage message if no arguments.
Allow ## in filename to mean #.  Same for %%.
Suppress warning message if lesskey.obj does not exist.
Fix the hack for Linux /proc files.
Make sure -e works with ESC-SPACE command.
Avoid duplicate define of off_t (also defined in compiler header file).
Use get_scrpos() for the special mark "."
Switch stdin to binary mode for MS-DOS, so pipes work properly.
Add warning about setlocale() treating 00 - 1F as control chars.
Use the word "option" instead of "flag" in messages.
Port to OS-9 Metaware compiler; minor fixes.
Use REG_EXTENDED on POSIX regcomp() to get extended regular expressions.
Try to avoid outputing hex constants into help.c.
Use tmodes() to use uniform method of getting mode enter/exit sequences from termcap.  Allows "me" to end a sequence if there isn't a specific end-sequence capability.
Do setmode() on pipes for Windows too.
Disable TAB filename completion till it works.
Define MSDOS compiler options before including defines.h.
Don't have distclean remove files which can't be recreated by the distribution.
Add ESC-( and ESC-). Fix bug which tried to free the LESSKEY filename when it wasn't malloced.
Add support for Microsoft Visual C under Windows. Fix a couple of bugs.
Add ESC-( and ESC-). Add description of --help and --version.
Describe extra string on quit command.
Fix bug in tags where tagfile pointed to a local buffer after the function had returned.
Fix bug in deleting the help file's IFILE while holding a reference to it.
Don't overrun obuf when adding the terminating null byte.
Add left/right arrows for horizontal scrolling. Save tty modes only on startup.
Add dependencies on funcs.h and cmd.h.
Fixes for Windows, Linux. Port to DJGPP.
Change names of Makefiles and defines files.
Add support for spaces in filenames.
Add lessecho; make spaces in filenames work on Unix.
Use unquote_file in a few more places.
Allow interrupt to break out of a :n or :p search for a valid file.
Remove trailing space on filename expansion.
Don't eat all the CPU time in a tight loop waiting for console input.
Fix bug with piping file that ends on bottom line of screen and -c.
Add support for LESS_TERMCAP_xx environment variables.
Make $LINES and $COLUMNS override system's idea of height and width.
Make alias for email address in .VER files.
In filename completion, append a "/" to directories.
Workaround bug in some systems' isupper() and tolower(). If the arg is negative, they do bad things.
Add open & close quotes; add -" option to change quotes.
Add comment about setting env vars in MS-DOS.
Escape all shell special characters, not just spaces.
Add LESSMETACHARS and LESSMETAESCAPE. Use escaping rather than quoting in shellcmd(), so shell commands which contain quotes will work.
Provide strchr() if system doesn't have it.
New version of popen for OS9.
Don't fail if currently no help.c or funcs.h.
Fix build if HAVE_SHELL is not set.
Caller of ch_init now sets CH_CANSEEK if it wants ch_init to even *try* to seek.  ch_init may still find it can't seek, in which case it will clear CH_CANSEEK.
Fix bug when buffer is bigger than display window. Still doesn't work quite right.
Change from netcom.com to fog.net Remove -h flag from tar (wasn't recognized by MKS tar).
Fix #196: ignore CAPS-LOCK & NUM-LOCK sequences on input.
Fix so tag match works on DOS-style text (line ends with \r \n).
Fix scrollable window problems in Windows. Simulate SIGWINCH in Windows.'
Fix make tagall to work with dumb rcs.
Change offset to unsigned to eliminate compiler warnings.
Change less.ini and lesskey.ini to _less and _lesskey.
Complain if extra chars at end of -D option (to catch missing $ after -D in LESS env var).
Quit after reading 20 consecutive nulls (fix for #143).
Add %d, %D. Make sure we don't overrun prompt buffer.
Make OXTABS take precedence over XTABS. Make sys_height,width take precedence over LINES,COLUMNS. Make default color be system color.
Add show_attn stuff. Use REG_NOTBOL in POSIX regexp to fix ^ search bug.
Attempt to fix Windows highlighting problems. (Better, but not completely fixed.)
Change to 4 digit year in date strings.
Output newline after return from lsystem (important for Windows where init() changes screen buffers).
Install man pages to the right directories.
Do something sensible in filesize() if fstat or _gs_size() fails.
mkinstalldirs should make mandir/man1, not mandir.
Add support for long option names.
Fix bug in \b. Fix bug in HOMEPATH: should set $HOME not $PATH.
Add multiple names for one option. Add --silent synonym for --quiet.
Allow "special" keys in lesskey files. Add \k syntax to lesskey. Add long options to lesskey.
Fix #204: maxlines wasn't working in prep_hilite.
Add notbol parameter to local V8 regexec2.
Just fixing some tabs in the source.
Allow either GPL or Less License.
Support WATCOM regexec. Add install-strip target.
Change default LESSCHARSET to latin1. Add HOME & END commands. Add %P and ?P in prompt strings. Allow search ending with $ on CRLF lines.
Change iprintf name to avoid conflict.
Don't allow :x on the help file.
Make -w highlight target line of g and p commands. Cleanup for v344 release.
Make -R pass thru ESC but not other control chars.
Fix bugs in long option processing.
Fix bug in displaying hilites after R after file changes.
Fix horizontal scrolling of long lines. Fixs for MS-DOS / DJGPP versions.
Escape metachars in lsystem and editproto.
Fix color problem in DJGPP version. Fix bug in :x on a file which contains marks.

Enable UTF-8 if "UTF-8" appears in locale-related env vars. Add --with-editor to configure. Fix bug in v command on filename with quotes, etc. Fix bug in horizontal scrolling. Fix bug in :d on file containing marks. Fixes for DJGPP version.
Make -M and = prompts include top & bottom line numbers. Update copyright to 2000 for v351.
Fix compile error when HAVE_POPEN is 0.
Allow space after numeric valued option letter.
Don't use STDC_HEADERS: check individual headers.
Add support for PCRE library. Add special-case in configure for HP-UX.
Add support for PCRE. Add --with-regex configure option. Add configure kludge for HP-UX B.11.00.
Add -# option. Use lmargin instead of tabstop to space after line number. Don't shift line number off screen when horizontally shifted.
Make horizontal shifting act as though -S were in effect.
Add -J option to display status column.
Fix bugs when #stop is used in lesskey file.
Default charset for DOS version is "dos".
More readable description of default charset.
Fix bad highlighting due to Windows bug.
Fix 32 bit dependencies. Fix UTF-8 overstriking. Fix EBCDIC host support.
Make status column show search targets.
Allow old sysless file for backwards compatibility. Add --no-keypad option. Add latin9 & charset aliases.
Allow line buffer to expand to handle very long lines.
Fix shifting text with ANSI color sequences.
Add warnings to man page about -R searching. Update copyright message.
Don't use BINDIR on Windows. Update email and homepage.
Save & restore console title for WIN32.
Don't set window title for help file.
Fix underlined tabs and bold tabs.
Add hash table for performance. Increase buffer size from 1024 to 8192.
Added t and T commands. Added support for "global(1)" tags.
Remove compiler warnings about unreferenced variables.
Must set LESSGLOBALTAGS to use the global command.
Allow option table to specify valid chars for a string option.
Warn if option string is not terminated correctly.
Right/left arrow while entering number are shift commands, not line edit.
Add next-tag, prev-tag, remove-file. Update default keys in man page.
Add homepage to --version output and man page.
Make sure _sysless is on C: drive.
Reset new_file in pr_string, not in pr_expand.
Make -t parsing be backwards compatible. (Allow argument to be not terminated with a $ sign.)
Make -b argument be in units of 1K.
Improve handling of filenames containing shell metachars.
Fix compilation for Windows. Remove some unreferenced variables.
Fix bug in parsing -x option from LESS variable. Change struct option to struct loption.
Fix missing quote in nroff source.
Print error message if use t/T when TAGS is not set.
Use file descriptor in tty variable rather than 2 to set raw mode.
Fixes for DJGPP build, from Eli.
Fix searching for lines with ANSI escape sequences.
Add files to ifile list in correct order if command line has duplicate filenames.
Fix problem with spaces in LESS variable.
Fix bug overstriking mulitbyte UTF-8 chars.
Fix bug in Windows version when file contains CR. Fix bug which caused default buffer space to be unlimited rather than 64K.
Fix bug in adj_hilite with -R and ANSI color escapes.
Fix some -Wall warnings. Fix bad const declarations. Fix char arg to getnum instead of char*.
Add -L option. Fix bug with invalid long option names. Fix some man page issues. Fix bug with ctrl-K in lesskey files.
Add context-sensitive overstriking of underscore with underscore.
Switch to autoconf 2.54. Use configure.ac, remove configure.in, defines.h.top, acconfig.h.
Make -N use 7 digits for line number unless need to use more. Fix bug in underlining UTF-8.
Fix bugs in crummy findopt_name function.
Fix off-by-one bug in reverse search when expanding linebuf. Thanks to Len Lattanzi.
Reconstruct version 394. Versions between 382 and 394 are lost.
Allow decimal point in numbers for commands. Currently only % command uses the fractional part.
Allow decimal point in number for -j option.
Allow n command to fetch last search pattern from history file. Allow up to 5 binary chars before calling it a binary file.
Add note about multibyte character sets (only UTF-8).
Check that CODESET is defined before using it.
Implement new bottom of screen behavior. Add --old-bot (temporarily?) to enable old behavior.
Document new bottom of screen behavior.
Don't interrupt a read of input file just for a window change signal.
Retry read from input in iread if read returns < 0 and errno == EINTR or EAGAIN.
Don't rewrite history file if it hasn't changed.
Revert extraneous newline change. Can't get it to work with long lines.
Reenable newbot behavior. Finally got it to work (I think).
Allow search to find text which follows a null byte, when using PCRE or no-regex (ctrl-R) searching.
Don't warn about binary file if -R is in effect and file contains only ANSI color sequences.

Fix bugs with doing clear_eol in the middle of output. This is problematic on ignaw terminals since the cursor may be stuck on the last column of the previous line and clear_eol just clears that char. Eliminate old -c mode to fix this.
Fix autoconf bug when memcpy etc are inline.
Don't require $ to terminate -j parameter in lesskey file.
Fix bug caused by clear_bot in forw() when long lines are displayed during an F command.
Fix display bug with -w. Need to move to lower left after moving up to display lines in clear_attn.
Fix secure build. In secure build, ignore shell commands in history file, rather than treating them as search commands.
Fix configure to include langinfo.h when testing for locale.
Add some checks for thisfile==NULL in ch.c functions. Fixes crash with "less -E file1 file2" when file2 does not exist.
Revert previous change -- allow WINCH signal to interrupt a read. This is necessary to make less resize the text when the window is changed.
Fix from Ivana Varekova for bug in going to EOF with no newline. Does not fix bug 199.
Accept either ESC-[ or CSI (0x9B) as a start of color escape sequence. Patch from Andreas Wetzel.
Fix -i/-I flags to work with non-ASCII characters.
Fix buffer overflow in cvt_text caused by invalid UTF-8 sequences.
Use wide version of ctype functions if available.
Converting to lowercase can make a string grow longer!
Use symbolic SEEK_xxx constants in lseek calls.
Fix adj_hilites to work when length of text changes when it is converted to lowercase.
Kludge to output an extra " \b" on ignaw terminals when we write a full line, to avoid having the cursor sitting in zombie mode on the right margin.
Clarify wording of --follow-name option in man page.
Fix swapped definitions of curr_ino & curr_dev.
Clarify some minor points in man page.
Fix crash when searching text containing invalid UTF-8 sequences.
Add support for EXEEXT in Makefile.
Don't use pound sign in temp file name since some systems don't like it.
Don't support single-char CSI when in UTF-8 mode. Prevent buffer overrun with invalid CSI sequence.
Fix bug in searching for text with embedded SGR sequences with -r.
Call cmd_exec before gomark to erase the "goto mark:" prompt.
Fix bugs in SGR emulation. Make SGR emulation work in WIN32C build.
Remove WARNINGS section. Clean up some text.
Remove unnecessary check for buffer overrun.
Use entire_file_displayed rather than eof_displayed when checking whether to quit due to -F. Get rid of hit_eof global.
Fix lastmark bug when jumping to EOF with G command.

Make status column display matches even if matched string is scrolled off screen because -S is in effect. Still doesn't work quite right with wrapped lines. I think it should display a star on ALL screen lines of the physical line.
Fix build with HILITE_SEARCH=0. Add some comments.
Change prompt to &: while filtering is in effect.
Ignore filtered lines while searching. Dispaly & in all prompts while filtering, not just default prompt.
Make & command display matched lines, not hide matched lines.
Fix bug in logic for handling no-wrap terminals.
Use "\r\n" instead of " \b" to force cursor to start of next line for non-autowrap terminals.
Fix compile bug with pcre. Don't filter the help file.
Fix non-ANSI-compliant code in list handling in ch.c. Fix a few warnings with gcc -Wall.
Make binary_char work correctly with UTF-8 text.
Don't chmod history file if it's not a regular file.
Don't need to save dir on Win32.
Fix SGR emulation: turn off one attribute shouldn't turn off all.
Fix problem interrupting the line number calculation for initial prompt. Get rid of nasty lnloop boolean.
Make sure u_interrupt calls bell() even if intread longjmps.

Nothing really.  Wanted to restore old behavior where ctrl-C before the Calculating message is printed aborts but does not turn off linenums. This never worked well if the line number request was for the prompt. So leave it like this: ctrl-C while calculating line numbers turns them off, no matter what was displayed.
Fix bug in highlighting search match if the matched string is underlined etc.
Don't pass "-" to non-pipe LESSOPEN unless it starts with a dash.
Allow decimal fraction as argument to the --shift option.
Search hilite not displayed if match extends to end of line.
Fix highlight bug when two search matches are adjacent.
Get rid of adj_hilite.  (Yippee!) Keep track of original char offsets in cvt_text instead.
Try another fix for the unsquashable ignaw terminal problem.
When a char in cvt_text's output represents more than one input char (eg. "a \b a" => "a"), make chpos be the position of the first source char, not the last.
Run gpg as part of make dist.
Make "please re-enter pattern" message work correctly.
Use floating point in percent calculations to avoid resolution limits due to overflow prevention.
Fix handling of long option names.
Split long functions into smaller pieces.
Make sure we can link floating point multiply and divide before setting HAVE_FLOAT.
Use linked list instead of fixed length array for ungot chars.
Allow negative sign in -j option parameter.
Fix bug in using & filtering with -i/-I: is_caseless was not getting set.
Fix bug with %t in prompts. Daniel Malament <danielm@bluetiger.net>
Exit with status 2 on control-C with -K.
Don't use current hilite to determine SEARCH_AFTER_TARGET.
Fix bug displaying prompt after = command which generates an internal unget. Fix bug erasing error message.
Fix loop in forw_line that doesn't exit on interrupt. Make -A behavior the default.
Fix search bug: "nothing to search" if backwards search with bottom line empty.
Fix search bug caused by inconsistent handling of unget variables.
Remove obsolete -l option that causes a crash.
Fix hilite bug scolling back with -J and -S and pattern is scrolled to right. Need to skip to eol in bacck_line so ch_tell later is correct.
Fix hilite bug with backspaces.  If a hilited match is not contiguous in the original file, need to create multiple hilite structs for it.
Add MORE environment variable to the list.
Handle CR as a move to start of line. This eliminates the need for pendc and its associated code.
Use new CR handling in -u mode.
Fix SGR emulation in Win32 compiler. From Eric Lee <saintgimp@hotmail.com>
Revert attempt to process CR better. Gets complicated by folded lines, multibyte chars, etc. Better leave this alone for now.

revert last change; caused display problems. need to rethink this. This whole design is flawed in that it can't handle a backspace sequence that backs up into a segment of the line that has already been output.  Yucko.
Add prefix matching to up/down line editing commands.
Add double-pipe syntax in LESSOPEN to use exit status.
Print name of regex library in version message.
Fix nondisplay of status column when scrolling backwards and match is past end of line with -S.
Fix bugs introduced by integrating supposed memory leak fix.
Put .lesshst file in XDG_CACHE_HOME if set.
Revert XDG until we have full support.
Fix bug which retained old EOF position after an ESC-F session. Fix bug which changed ESC-F to plain F after non-abort signal (window resize).
Can't fcomplete a quoted filename on MSDOS.
Fix for stty 0, from Andreas Schwab
Fix for --with-regex=none and some cosmetic issues. Based on fix from g.esp@free.fr.
Allow backslash escaping in command line options ($LESS). Don't quit if syntax errors in command line options.
Allow pos 0 to be in a pos table considered "epmpty". This is a quick hack fix for the forw-forever in empty file bug.
Fix option string parsing incompatibility. Option string should end at dollar only, not space, tab or dash.
In cmd_updown, don't copy new string into cmdbuf before calling cmd_home, which needs the old string to determine how far to step left.
Incremental search. Not fully functional yet. This version was emailed to matthewlmcclure@gmail.com on 6/19/13.
In incremental search, allow pattern entry even if prefix of the pattern is an invalid pattern.
Call put_wchar to avoid duplicate code.
Force BS_SPECIAL when viewing help file.
Don't overwrite history file; just append new entries.
searchstack only used by incremental search.
Use more portable char for temp file name.
Larger hash table for better performance.
In more mode, -p should apply to every file.
Fix bugs & improve performance with ampersand filtering. From John Sullivan
MSDOS fixes and leak fixes from Jason Hood
Change type of get_time() to time_type, not long.
Use REGS_UNALLOCATED since gnu regex seems to write past the end of the registers array if you allocate it yourself.
Use explicit END_COMMAND char instead of checking whether cmdbuf is empty when ungetcc runs out. This allows extra chars in lesskey file to append to a search command without executing it.
Fix some compiler warnings on 64 bit architectures.
Allow compiled value of LESSHISTFILE = "-" to disable history.
Clear forw_prompt after printing stuff; this fixes prompt bug with -^P in lesskey extra string from stdin.
Fix crash with -g and search for non-match.
In follow mode, reopen file if it shrinks.
Can't call adjsline with BOTTOM_PLUS_ONE parameter.
remove file if exists and not writable.
Fix possible buffer overrun with non-well-formed UTF-8 sequences.
Fix off-by-one error in jump_forw_buffered. Don't add FAKE_* files to cmd history.
Fix nonportable pointer usage; caused unaligned access exception on Sparc.
No-regex searches with upper-case were not working.
Call init_cmds before reading environment variables (so #env works)
In building wide.uni, count Fullwidth chars as Wide.
Regenerate hilite when changing search caselessness. (from Jason Hood).
Fix bug when terminal has no "cm" (from Noel Cragg). Add s command to help. Handle shift-TAB in DOS (from Jason Hood).
Revert last change, breaks arrow keys.
Fix "nothing to search" bug when top/bottom line is empty.
Update Windows makefile per Jason Hood.
Fix debugging feature: hex mode char entry.
Fix incorrect display when entering double-width chars in search string.
New commands ESC-{ and ESC-} to shift to start/end of displayed lines.
New option -Da in Windows version to enable SGR mode.
Make chop marker work for backwards movement.
Revert chop marker; not working right and don't feel like debugging it.
With -F, do not output ti/te if file fits on one screen.
Fix inconsistent types of jump_sline_fraction and shift_count_fraction.
Use ANSI prototypes in funcs.h declarations. Fix const issues. Remove register declarations.
Don't use struct tags before defining it.
Use VOID_PARAM in declaration of functions with no parameters.
Make Cf chars composing (zero width printable), not binary.
Call init_cmds before get_term, so get_term can use env variables set in the lesskey file.
Do cvt filtering for tags matching.
Revert previous change (arrow keys don't work).
Add right scroll truncation indicator LESSRSCROLL.
Don't show rscroll indicator if -S is off.
Do cvt processing for ANSI colors used in syntax coloring for tags.
Don't flush buffers for popened (LESSOPEN) input when closing file (eg. view help file and return).
Fix off-by-one error that truncated a line too early if the last displayed char was double-width.
Allow TERMCAP_ env vars in lesskey file.
Reset cursor before executing tags movement commands.
Expand cmd tables in separate step to allow init_cmds to precede get_term.
Revert bin_file change.  Percent based algorithm doesn't work well on small files.
Make undo search stop searching, not just hide the highliting.
Expose expand_cmd_tables as a separate step so we can call init_cmds before get_term.
Allow * and attribute at start of LESSRSCROLL.
Change setbinfmt -> setfmt and pass pointer to attribute.
Make sure rscroll char is standout by default.
Control rscroll char via command line option, not env variable.
Change mkhelp.c to mkhelp.pl Make sure opt_rsearch gets called at startup.
Add M command. Make attn mark appear even if attn line is zero length.
Add M and ESC-M commands. Fix buffering bug when using stdin with LESSOPEN pipe (h,q displays corrupt data).
Better fix for ensuring 0x00 bytes are detected as binary in utf-8 mode. Warn if no %s in LESSOPEN, not only if >1. Tabs.
Add M and ESC-M commands to lesskey.
Windows: if console is not UTF-8, convert UTF-8 to multibyte output.
Windows: handle "extended" chars, where first byte is \340.
Revamp how shell quoted filenames are handled. Fixes some bugs in viewing files with strange names like \.

Move some globals into struct ifile because there can be more than one. If LESSOPEN is used to read stdin, the pipe cannot be closed when another file is read.  So there may be two altpipes open at the same time.
Don't reopen an ifile that is already open.
Fix underlined punctuation in man page.
Fix bug in determining when to reopen a file.
Override some chars marked as control in unicode tables but are expected to be found in normal text files.
With -R, fix switching to normal attribute at end of line when using rscroll.
Fix bug in fcomplete when pattern does not match any file.
On Windows, allow 'u' in -D option to enable underline.
Fix bug using LESSOPEN with filenames containing shell metachars.
Make status column show search matches even if hiliting is disabled via -G.
Use underline in sgr mode in MSDOS.
Fix rscroll bug when last char of line starts coloration.
Fix binary file warning when UTF-8 file contains SGR sequences.
Convert keypad Enter sequence to newline.
Need to use LWCHAR not char in several places (must hold CHAR_END_COMMAND).
Can't use an array of LWCHAR as a char array.
Change M command to mark bottom line on screen.
Fix search hilite bug introduced in v517.

lesstest: Makefile: allow CFLAGS to be overitten

Make clean on Windows should delete defines.h.
Change Windows underline color to more readable bright green. Fix type error.
Adjust Windows underline color so foreground is visible regardless of background color.

Restructure edit_ifile(). It now tries to open the new file first, and then if that succeeds, it closes the old (currently open) file. If reedit_ifile failed, this could cause unintended recursion:
win32: Fix to handle files larger than 4 GiB
Improve parsing of string options -j, -x and -#. Don't accept "-" and "." anywhere in string, but only at beginning.
When opening controlling tty, try /dev/tty before ttyname(). Also open tty (open_getchr) before calling get_term, so that tty file descriptor can be used by ioctls in get_term.

Workaround some apparent untrustworthiness in ReadConsoleInputW. It sometimes delivers a faulty KeyDown event where the codepoint is set to zero. The subsequent KeyUp event always seems to have the correct codepoint.
WideCharToMultiByte does not handle codepoints >= 0x10000, so use put_wchar.
Do "last_down" processing for bogus KeyDown events only for non-ASCII chars. Remove unnecessary .ascii field from KeyRecord.
Fix bug with search for multibyte UTF-8 characters. cvt_text was setting the chpos[] entry for only the first byte of the character. It should set the entry for every byte.
Fix incorrect calculation of codepoint from UTF-16 surrogate pair.
After processing a high surrogate char, immediately try to read the next char (the low surrogate). Don't say there is no char available.
Don't filter header lines via the & command.
Use simpler and more efficient algorithm to make search match visible when -S is in effect.
Create pos_rehead to fix bugs when we go into chopline mode with a "beheaded" position table (that is, when position(TOP) is not the first char in its line).
Fix pos_rehead when -S doesn't change, but chopping changes due to hshift changing.
Minor cleanup. Privatize global variable screen_trashed, add screen_trashed() and related functions
If search match is visible in unshifted screen (hshift==0), set the screen to unshifted. Previous version would prefer to keep the current hshift if >0.
lesstest: Add -x option to explore a .lt file. Add -D option to create or read a failure details file.
lesstest: add extract script to extract text file from an lt file.
Fix bug in rrshift (ESC-}) when beginning of file is scrolled down, so that position(TOP)==NULL_POSITION.
Fix erroneous display with --incsearch when entering chars in a search pattern should cause the display to horizontally scroll.
Allow --match-shift to take a decimal fraction, like -#.
Rewrite and clean up Windows input handling code. Replace multiple state variables with a single unified queue. Also fixes invalid input when mouse events occur at column >= 95.
On Windows, make "waiting for data" message indicate that ^X can interrupt.

On Windows, if keys are pressed while "Waiting for data" is displayed, call ungetcc_back() rather than WIN32ungetch() to unget them. They should be read by the command processor, not re-read by the keyboard input code.
Change default charset on Windows (WIN32C) from dos to utf-8.

Revert 04746adebaa882844a054b50be33fa44b8252664; this lets iread inappropriately break up a multi-char input sequence. Also make WIN32ungetch() push the char on the front of the queue rather than the back.
Remove long-obsolete UTF-8 support for Unicode chars larger than U+10FFFF.

Refactor fexpand() to reuse code between the two passes.

Doc. Improve description of MS-DOS-specific behavior of --color. Change some attr variable names to cattr for consistency.
Make help file consistent in use of brackets around optional input. If an option reports state when invoked with no parameter, its parameter should be documented as optional.
Allow --rscroll to accept a non-ASCII character.

Fix bug introduced in 64464509e9dc1b27961744ff72eaedd672e7172c, where first character of file is not displayed when using LESSOPEN. Since this change, when viewing a new file while another file is already open, the new file is opened first and then the current file is closed. When the new file is opened, open_altfile reads a char from the new file to see if it is empty, and then calls ch_ungetchar to unget it, so that it will later be the first char read from the file. But when closing the old file, close_altfile calls ch_ungetchar(-1) which overwrites the ungotten char. This call was added in 05e12cd1. I'm not exactly sure why it was added, but it seems unnecessary and removing it fixes this problem.
Remove unused label to fix compiler warning.
Fix bug when viewing a file whose name contains a newline.

Fix incorrect display when filename contains control chars. Such chars should not be printed directly to the screen, but instead passed through prchar() or prutfchar().

fix crash - buffer overflow by one in fexpand
Revert unintentional commit of experimental changes.

Fix double free in parse_lesskey. Fix passing NULL to strcmp and fopen in parse_lesskey if homefile returns NULL. Fix invalid lesskey filename in error messages if there is a syntax error in a --lesskey-content parameter.

Allow TAB in the -- command to complete a partial option name. Related to #531.

Fix bug in ixerror, used when displaying the interrupt char during the F command. Since 2a642a07d86f7f9484db18cd748bc521e71c997f, less_printf can call prchar, thus overwriting the static buffer returned by prchar. Need to save the result of prchar across a call to less_printf.

Fix problem when set-mark command is defined in a lesskey file with the mark letter in the "extra" string, and then invoked in the help file. The set-mark command is ignored in the help file, so the mark letter is interpreted as a command. We now read and discard one command char after deciding to ignore a set-mark because we're in the help file. Do this only if the char comes from the extra string (it is ungotten).

Add support for mouse drag. With --mouse, dragging will scroll text forward and backward. Single clicking still sets the # mark, but a click and drag would previously set a mark where the drag ends. Now the drag scrolls the text, and no mark is set when the drag ends.

Flush output before starting a potentially time-consuming search operation. Without this, buffered data may be not written or only partially written to the screen, so the screen could look inconsistent while the search operation is in progress. Related to #533.
Simpler fix for ixerror bug. Use stack rather than heap to save prchar output.
Change missing_cap from int to lbool.

Improve passthru of OSC sequences. All OSC sequences in a prompt are passed thru. LESSANSIOSCALLOW specifies which OSC sequences in the file contents are passed thru. LESSANSIOSCCCHARS specifies nonstandard OSC intro chars, and specifies which of them are allowed in file contents.

Rewrite command decoder. Change [fe]cmd_decode so instead of returning only commands that match the entire cmd string, we return commands that match a tail of the cmd string. This allows spurious leading chars in command entry to be ignored. Related to #543.

Fix bug in new command decoder. If we find a partial match (prefix) which is longer than an previous match, take the partial match even if the previous match was exact. Previously, for example, if we get the paste bracket "\e[200~", it would parse the '\e' and '[' as A_PREFIX, but then it would parse the '2' as A_DIGIT instead of A_PREFIX.
Fix regression in new command decoder: If there are two identical commands in a command table, accept the later one.
If we find matches for a command in multiple command tables, take the longest match.
Fix step_char to work better with malformed UTF-8 sequences. If we encounter a malformed sequence, just step one byte at a time.
Fix typo in gnu-upload target in Makefile.aut.
